card.name: Degree words after at or with
card.fires_on: Words that set a degree or amount right after "at", "with" or "the", such as record, half, minimum, lower, same, unprecedented. The next word is expected to be a noun like rate, cost, scale or effort.

modes.label: Degree word after at/with
modes.description: A word like half, minimum, lower or record that sets the level before a noun such as dose, rate or cost.
modes.example: start ENTRESTO at<< half>> the usually recommended starting dose

modes.label: Money amount unit
modes.description: The m after a pound price in a transfer fee.
modes.example: Sunderland A.F.C. from Scottish club Heart of Midlothian for £9<<m>> on August 7 200

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning "in the manner of" and "the same way", which fits a way or degree phrase coming next.
card.plain: It fires on words that say how much or to what degree, like half, minimum or record, just before the thing being measured.
